notes.title: Asteroid Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176762/d0dc121969ae476604b9d159c2190a352efab6d4.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

We changed the Asteroid belt to have the resources within the asteroids show through, and we also got rid of empty asteroids.

We fixed a small inventory bug that had to do with placing an ally fighter aircraft in your inventory. 

We got rid of the cost to shoot while inside of a turret. 

We have also changed the price of some items and resources.

Hope you enjoy,

Core Reaction Studios Team

Send any bugs to: support@corereactionstudios.com

And send any feedback to: feedback@corereactionstudios.com

We really enjoy hearing from you and making the game even better!

notes.title: Turret/Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176762/072796a372357c46037fd57a26c40c656df853b1.png[/img]

We've added in turrets to better counter enemy artillery. The Missile Silo turret targets and blows up artillery. The Shrapnel Shield defends adjacent turrets with a protective shield. The Anti-artillery turret shoots down enemy missiles. 

We've also made the tutorial nicer looking and easier to follow. Additionally we've made a few graphical changes. Finally, we have balanced the game more and are still making it just right.

Have fun,

Core Reaction Studios Team

notes.title: Balance Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

It has come to our attention that the game is too difficult at first. So we have lowered the amount of bombers and enemy ships that will attack you early on. Also, we have buffed the Anti-Air turrets and the Ally-Fighter. We are working on adding an Easy, Medium, and Hard mode, more on this in the future.

Thanks everyone who has given us feedback and hope you enjoy!

CoreReactionStudios Team
